msg: Hello!Each of the gnomes are "paired" with another gnome and they will always appear together; orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow and blue & purple.Each gnome will lead you to a different forest with either a red basket or a yellow basket.The orange, green, red and blue gnomes will lead you to a forest with a red basket. And the brown, pink, yellow and purple will take you to a forest with a yellow basket.The amount of available mushrooms in each forest changes every so often so you have to figure out which is the one with the most mushrooms.You will have to pay attention to this, especially when you get the 5x multiplier as you can gain a lot of mushrooms very easily.The gnomes size, hats and positions do NOT matter and makes no difference to the outcome. Only the colour of the gnome matters.Good luck!
